summary: Banco Bradesco filed a 6-K reporting the auction of remaining unsubscribed shares from its R$10bn capital increase and board ratification of the full subscription of 604,852,753 new shares (302,876,396 common; 301,976,357 preferred) at R$15.43 and R$17.64, respectively. The October 2 B3 auction sold all 1,505,454 common and 14,553,057 preferred receipts at R$15.50/R$17.86, grossing R$283.25m, with the R$3.31m premium to capital reserve. The increase awaits Central Bank of Brazil ratification before shares are credited within three business days; post-ratification capital rises from R$93.77bn to R$103.77bn. Watch BACEN approval and share overhang.
